about_the_game:
In this free demo version of Necrologium you'll step into the shoes of a forensic doctor facing  misterious series of murders that will test your investigative skills, and unravel the dark secrets that you will face in this experience.

Dare to delve into the macabre?

A group of people have met their end in a mansion under mysterious circumstances. James Milton, a distinguished detective and forensic expert, is called upon to solve his final case.
Only the solitary sound of rain accompanies his days spent among the dead and their haunting whispers.
Each secret they reveal brings him one step closer to a chilling truth. This time, however, ancient esoteric tools gifted by an enigmatic presence give a new dimension to his investigation, allowing the detective to delve into the lives and sins of the victims.

An entire laboratory at your disposal!

Your investigation will focus on performing autopsies on the unfortunate victims who, just hours ago, were inhabiting the Bolden's Mansion. Every tiny detail could be the key to uncovering the reason behind their untimely demise.

  • Use every tool at your disposal to reveal even the smallest clue.

  • A unique daguerreotype camera will allow you to examine the victims' fates more closely.

  • Combine science and the esoterism in your alchemical lab to create photographic reagents that unveil shocking truths.

Finally, rely on your trusty detective's board to connect each victim to their killer and bring this harrowing case to a close.

In this demo version you will find:

  • The first two introductory cases in the mystery of the villa!

  • The spiritual camera, where the destinies of the victims are revealed and their fates are sealed.

  • Strange alchemical ingredients for crafting reagents in the alchemy lab.

  • The crucial detective’s board key to unraveling the first piece of this eerie and shadowy puzzle.

※Note that you will not be able to carry over your save data from the demo into the full game.

content_descriptors.notes: Please be advised, the game contains strong imagery and themes that may affect a particularly sensitive audience.
